name: Sleeping or paused
when: Idle for a while, or paused by you

variants.name: Nightcap
variants.desc: Nightcap on, eyes shut, little moons drifting up.

variants.name: Paused
variants.desc: Frozen mid-move under a pause sign.

variants.name: Dream
variants.desc: Dreams of a moon and a twinkling star.

variants.name: Snooze
variants.desc: Flattened into a loaf with a little sleep bubble.

variants.name: Lullaby
variants.desc: Rocks gently under a moon and stars.
